TITLE: ATM & Debit Card Services
INTRO_1: ATM services allow customers to access their bank accounts conveniently through Automated Teller Machines.
INTRO_2: Customers can perform basic banking transactions securely without visiting the branch.
CASH_WITHDRAWAL: Cash withdrawal facility available through ATMs.
MINI_STATEMENT: View mini statement of recent transactions.
PIN_CHANGE: Change ATM PIN securely at ATMs.
INTEROPERABLE: ATM card can be used at other bank ATMs as per applicable rules.
CARD_ISSUANCE: Debit card is issued to customers holding a savings or current account.
BRANCH_COLLECTION: Customers can collect their debit card from the bank branch after account opening.
ATM_USAGE: Debit card can be used for ATM withdrawals and balance enquiries.
SECURITY: Customers are advised to keep their ATM PIN confidential for security reasons.
